matter: Elena Rivera v. Northstar Logistics LLC

expected_core_facts.fact: Collision occurred on March 12, 2025 at approximately 8:14 a.m.
Owen Price drove a Northstar Logistics delivery van.
Price reported looking down at the route screen immediately before entering the intersection.
Price acknowledged the dispatch message at 8:13:51 a.m.
Dr. Miriam Chen assessed acute cervical strain and right-shoulder contusion.
Marcus Lee's view of the traffic signal was partly blocked.
Marcus Lee could not rule out that the signal changed before impact.
Store camera timestamp shows impact at 08:14:37.

positions: Rivera alleges the signal changed from yellow to red.
Northstar contends the signal was green.
Marcus Lee thought it looked green but his view was obstructed and he could not rule out a change.

must_not_assert: Marcus Lee had an unobstructed view of the signal.
The documented $16,452.75 total includes noneconomic damages.
test_questions: What evidence concerns the route screen?
What are the documented economic damages?
What conflicts exist about the traffic signal?
What medical treatment did Elena Rivera receive?
